original_content_observations.observation: Opening describes warming as seemingly relatively benign so far, then reports scientific uncertainties.
Predicts relatively less damaging near-term warming and possible longer growing seasons, an attributed scientific view not an editorial proof of the whole field.
Agrees some observed warming concentrates at night but disputes Michaels on pollution-related cloud effects and longer-term warming.
